integration_issues.issue: Automation could not detect a say-bar element after walking toward Lyra (~3 diagonal steps only got player to (341,478); Lyra ~ (320,360)). Say-bar likely renders on canvas rather than as DOM node, or requires closer proximity. Visual behavior not verified but no error was thrown.

issues: Rotate-prompt overlay ('Continue in Portrait') remains visible AFTER rotating to 844x390 landscape — expected to auto-dismiss when orientation is already landscape. Minor UX polish item.

xy-btn-* mobile controls exist (6/6) and were 6/6 in-viewport in portrait, but after rotating to landscape 844x390 all 6 buttons sit below the fold because parent-page header/description/HUD consume the small 390px height. Recommend either compressing parent chrome in landscape or auto-triggering fullscreen container when a mobile viewport enters landscape.

action_items: MINOR (design): hide the in-iframe rotate-prompt when window.matchMedia('(orientation: landscape)').matches so it doesn't sit on top of a landscape canvas.
MINOR (layout): in mobile landscape (viewport height < ~500), auto-collapse parent chrome or auto-enter the fullscreen container so xy-btn-* mobile controls remain inside the viewport.
